how to upload apk in github release
Create a new release on GitHub, drag the APK file into the assets section, then publish the release.
step guide

1. Open your repository on GitHub and click “Releases” in the right‑hand menu.  
2. Click “Draft a new release”.  
3. Choose a tag version (or create a new tag) and give the release a title and description.  
4. Drag your APK file onto the “Attach binaries by dropping them here” area or click “Select files” to browse for it.  
5. Wait for the upload to finish, then click “Publish release”.  

Your APK will now be available as a downloadable asset on that release page.
